classification.difficultyReason: Identify the outer and inner composite areas and subtract to find a practical resurfacing area.

inlines.text: The racetrack shown needs to be resurfaced.
Calculate the area to be resurfaced to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Nested horizontal stadium shapes. The shaded band is the track surface. The outer height is labelled outside the left end, the inner height is labelled vertically at the left straight-section join, and the straight length is labelled below between the joins.
spec.mathematics: Both straight rectangular sections are 40 m long. Outer diameter 20 m gives radius 10 m; inner diameter 15 m gives radius 7.5 m. Each pair of semicircular ends forms one circle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and the measured region are visible; no calculated radii or areas appear.

answer.worked:
Each oval consists of a rectangle and two semicircles. The two semicircles form one circle. Subtract the inner area from the outer area.
$$\begin{align*}
A_{\text{outer}} &= 40\times20+\pi(10)^2\\
A_{\text{outer}} &= 800+100\pi\\
A_{\text{inner}} &= 40\times15+\pi(7.5)^2\\
A_{\text{inner}} &= 600+56.25\pi\\
A_{\text{track}} &= (800+100\pi)-(600+56.25\pi)\\
A_{\text{track}} &= 200+43.75\pi\\
A_{\text{track}} &\approx 337.44\,\mathrm{m}^2
\end{align*}$$
